changes: Date year normalised to 1620. The chronogram is read as dyu (sky = 0) + akṣi (2) + ṛtu (6) + gotrā (earth = 1); reversed this gives 1620, so ŚS 1620 = 1698 CE. The note's alternatives (1621/1622) are dropped.
Notes rewritten to explain the chronogram properly.
Persons, roles and the Bhāskara–Candreśvara relation are kept as they were.

notes: The chronogram '(dyva)kṣiṛtu(gotr)ā' is partly uncertain. It is best read as dyu (sky = 0) + akṣi (eyes = 2) + ṛtu (seasons = 6) + gotrā (earth = 1). Reversed, this gives Śaka 1620 (1698 CE), which matches the catalogue. The doubtful points are the corrupt 'dyva' and reading gotrā as 'earth'. The verse says Candreśvara wrote it 'together with Bhāskara' (bhāskareṇa samāyuktaṃ), so Bhāskara is taken as a co-scribe or helper (medium confidence).
